title: Valid Parentheses (Code War Chain)
inputFormat: A single string s consisting of bracket characters.
outputFormat: A single line output as described by the current stage.

stages.title: Stage 1 - Count Brackets
stages.statement: Given a string `s`, print two space-separated integers: the total number of opening brackets `(`, `[`, `{` and the total number of closing brackets `)`, `]`, `}`.

stages.title: Stage 2 - Balanced Counts
stages.statement: Print `1` if the total number of opening brackets exactly equals the total number of closing brackets, otherwise print `0`.

stages.title: Stage 3 - Valid Parentheses (Single Type)
stages.statement: The string will only contain `(` and `)`. Print `1` if it is a valid parenthesis sequence (properly closed and nested), otherwise print `0`.

stages.title: Stage 4 - Valid Parentheses (All Types)
stages.statement: The string contains all types of brackets `()[]{}`. Print `1` if it is a valid sequence, otherwise print `0`.

stages.title: Stage 5 - Maximum Nesting Depth
stages.statement: For a valid string of `()[]{}` brackets, print the maximum nesting depth. If the string is NOT valid, print `-1`.

stages.title: Stage 6 - Minimum Additions to Make Valid
stages.statement: The string contains only `(` and `)`. Print the minimum number of parentheses that must be added to make the sequence valid.

stages.title: Stage 7 - Longest Valid Parentheses Substring
stages.statement: The string contains only `(` and `)`. Print the length of the longest contiguous valid parentheses substring.
